recipes.name: Miso-glazed black cod with ginger rice

ingredients.name: black cod fillets, skin on (or any firm white fish)

method: Mix the miso, honey, rice vinegar and soy sauce. Coat the fish and leave for 10 minutes (or up to a day in the fridge).
Rinse the rice and cook with 300ml water and half the ginger, finely grated, for 12 minutes with the lid on, then rest for 5 minutes.
Heat the grill to high. Wipe off the excess glaze, place the fish skin-side down on an oiled, foil-lined tray and grill for 8-10 minutes until caramelised and flaking.
Cut the rest of the ginger into fine matchsticks and slice the spring onions.
Serve the fish on the rice, topped with ginger, spring onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Saffron seafood paella with charred lemon

ingredients.name: mussels, cleaned (discard any open ones that don't close when tapped)

method: Soak the saffron in the hot stock. Dice the onion and pepper; slice the garlic.
Heat the oil in a wide pan and soften the onion and pepper for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute, then stir in the rice to coat.
Pour in the saffron stock, stir once, then simmer without stirring for 15 minutes.
Push the prawns, mussels and squid into the rice, scatter over the peas, cover and cook for 6-8 minutes until the mussels open and the prawns are pink. Discard any mussels that stay closed.
Meanwhile, halve the lemons and char them cut-side down in a dry pan. Serve the paella with the charred lemon and chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Beef fillet with peppercorn jus and fondant potatoes
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Peel the potatoes and cut into thick cylinders, about 4cm tall.
Brown the potatoes in half the butter and the oil for 4 minutes each side. Add half the stock and the thyme, then bake for 35-40 minutes until tender.
Season the steaks and sear in a very hot pan for 3 minutes each side for medium-rare. Rest for 5 minutes.
In the same pan, soften the finely chopped shallot, add the peppercorns and brandy, then the remaining stock. Reduce by half and whisk in the remaining butter.
Boil the green beans for 4 minutes. Serve the steak with the fondant potatoes, beans and peppercorn jus.

recipes.name: Duck breast with cherry reduction and celeriac purée
method: Peel and chop the celeriac. Simmer in the milk with a splash of water for 20 minutes until soft, then blend with the butter and season.
Score the duck skin, season, and place skin-side down in a cold pan. Cook over a medium heat for 10-12 minutes to render the fat, then turn and cook for 3-4 minutes. Rest for 5 minutes.
Pour off most of the fat. Add the cherries, wine, stock and honey and simmer for 6-8 minutes until syrupy.
Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes. Slice the duck and serve on the purée with the cherry sauce.

recipes.name: Lamb rack with pistachio crust and pomegranate couscous
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Season the lamb and brown it all over in a hot pan.
Finely chop the pistachios with half the mint. Brush the fat side of the lamb with mustard and press on the crust.
Roast for 15-18 minutes for pink. Rest for 8 minutes.
Pour 150ml boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with the olive oil and lemon juice.
Stir the diced cucumber, pomegranate and the rest of the mint into the couscous. Carve the lamb and serve.

recipes.name: Wild mushroom truffle risotto with crispy sage
method: Soak the porcini in 150ml of the hot stock, then chop and add the liquid back to the stock.
Soften the chopped onion in half the butter and the oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18-20 minutes until the rice is creamy but still has a little bite.
Meanwhile, fry the mushrooms in a hot pan until golden. Fry the sage leaves in a little oil until crisp.
Stir the mushrooms, porcini, remaining butter and cheese into the risotto. Serve with a few drops of truffle oil and the crispy sage.

recipes.name: Lobster linguine with chilli, garlic and lemon

ingredients.name: cooked lobster (about 500g), or 200g cooked lobster meat

method: Remove the lobster meat from the shell and cut into chunks.
Cook the linguine in well-salted water for 9-10 minutes. Keep a cup of the cooking water.
Gently warm the sliced garlic and chilli in the olive oil for 2 minutes. Add the halved tomatoes for 3 minutes.
Add the lobster, lemon zest and juice, and the drained pasta with a splash of cooking water. Toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Serve scattered with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Seared scallops with pea purée and crispy pancetta
method: Boil the peas for 3 minutes, drain, then blend with the butter, a few mint leaves and seasoning until smooth.
Fry the pancetta until crisp, then drain on kitchen paper.
Pat the scallops dry and season. Sear in a very hot oiled pan for 1-2 minutes each side until golden but just translucent in the centre.
Spoon the purée onto plates, add the scallops and crumble over the pancetta. Finish with a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Harissa cauliflower steak with whipped tahini and jeweled rice
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Cut two thick steaks from the middle of the cauliflower (roast the rest alongside).
Mix the harissa and oil, brush over the cauliflower and roast for 25-30 minutes, turning once, until charred and tender.
Cook the rice for 12 minutes. Stir through the chopped apricots, pomegranate, almonds and herbs.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, grated garlic and 3-4 tbsp cold water until light and smooth.
Serve the cauliflower on the rice with the whipped tahini.

recipes.name: Salmon en croûte with lemon-dill sauce
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Wilt the spinach, squeeze out the water and mix with the soft cheese, lemon zest and half the chopped dill.
Unroll the pastry, lay the salmon in the middle, top with the spinach mix and fold the pastry over to make a parcel. Seal, glaze with egg and score the top.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden. Boil the potatoes alongside for 15-20 minutes.
Mix the crème fraîche with the lemon juice and remaining dill.
Slice the salmon en croûte and serve with the potatoes and lemon-dill sauce.

recipes.name: Aubergine parmigiana with basil and burrata
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Slice the aubergines lengthways, brush with oil and roast or griddle for 15-20 minutes until soft and golden.
Simmer the tomatoes with the sliced garlic and half the basil for 15 minutes until thick. Season.
Layer the aubergine, sauce and grated cheese in a dish, finishing with sauce and cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling.
Tear the burrata over the top, scatter with the remaining basil and serve with rocket.
notes: Uses vegetarian hard cheese instead of parmesan, so it's suitable for vegetarians.

recipes.name: Steak tagliata with rocket, parmesan and balsamic
method: Bring the steak to room temperature, rub with a little oil, rosemary and seasoning.
Sear in a very hot pan for 2-3 minutes each side for medium-rare. Rest for 5 minutes.
Toss the rocket and halved tomatoes with the remaining oil.
Slice the steak thinly, lay over the salad and finish with shaved cheese and balsamic.

recipes.name: Crispy-skin sea bass with fennel and orange salad
method: Shave the fennel very thinly. Peel and slice the orange, catching the juice.
Toss the fennel, orange, rocket and olives with the orange juice, vinegar and half the oil.
Pat the fish skin dry and season. Fry skin-side down in the remaining oil over a medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes, pressing gently so the skin stays flat, until crisp.
Turn and cook for 1 minute more. Serve on the salad, skin-side up.

recipes.name: Butter-poached prawns with saffron orzo
method: Soak the saffron in the stock. Soften the chopped shallot in a little butter for 3 minutes.
Add the orzo and stir, then add the stock and simmer for 10-12 minutes, stirring often, until creamy. Stir in the spinach.
Melt the rest of the butter with the sliced garlic over a low heat. Add the prawns and poach gently for 3-4 minutes until pink.
Spoon the orzo into bowls, top with the prawns and garlic butter, lemon juice and parsley.

recipes.name: Gochujang glazed short ribs with sesame slaw
method: Heat the oven to 160C (140C fan). Brown the ribs all over in a casserole dish.
Mix the gochujang, soy, honey, garlic and ginger. Coat the ribs, add the stock, cover and cook for 2.5-3 hours until very tender.
Lift out the ribs, skim the fat and reduce the sauce until sticky. Return the ribs and coat in the glaze.
Shred the cabbage and carrots and toss with the sesame oil, vinegar and sesame seeds.
Serve the ribs with rice and the slaw.

recipes.name: Burrata, heritage tomato and peach salad
method: Slice the tomatoes and peaches and arrange on a plate. Season with salt and pepper.
Place the burrata in the middle and tear it open.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic, scatter with basil and serve with toasted sourdough.

recipes.name: Crab and avocado brioche rolls
method: Mix the crab with the mayonnaise, half the lime juice, chopped chives and seasoning.
Mash the avocado with the remaining lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Split and lightly toast the rolls. Fill with lettuce, avocado and crab, and finish with chilli flakes.

recipes.name: Roast beef and horseradish sourdough tartines
method: Mix the horseradish with the crème fraîche.
Toast the sourdough and spread with the horseradish cream.
Top with the roast beef, watercress, thinly sliced red onion and sliced cornichons. Season with black pepper.

recipes.name: Whipped ricotta with roasted grapes and pistachios
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Roast the grapes with the oil and thyme for 12-15 minutes until blistered.
Whip the ricotta with a pinch of salt until smooth.
Toast the sourdough. Spread with ricotta, top with the warm grapes, pistachios and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Smoked salmon, dill and caper rye open sandwiches
method: Spread the rye bread with soft cheese.
Top with smoked salmon, thinly sliced red onion and capers.
Finish with dill, a squeeze of lemon and black pepper.

recipes.name: Saffron-cardamom French toast with berries
method: Warm 2 tbsp of the milk and soak the saffron in it for 5 minutes. Whisk with the eggs, remaining milk and cardamom.
Soak each slice of bread in the mixture for 20 seconds per side.
Fry in the butter over a medium heat for 2-3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with the berries, yoghurt and a drizzle of maple syrup.

recipes.name: Smoked salmon and soft scrambled eggs on brioche
method: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a pan over a low heat. Add the eggs and stir slowly for 3-4 minutes until just set and soft. Stir in the crème fraîche off the heat.
Toast the brioche. Top with the eggs, smoked salmon, snipped chives and black pepper.

recipes.name: Ricotta pancakes with roasted figs and honey
method: Heat the grill. Halve the figs, drizzle with half the honey and grill for 5 minutes until soft.
Separate the eggs. Mix the ricotta, yolks, flour, baking powder and sugar. Whisk the whites to soft peaks and fold in.
Fry spoonfuls of batter in a little butter over a medium heat for 2-3 minutes each side.
Serve the pancakes with the figs and the remaining honey.

recipes.name: Shakshuka with feta and fresh herbs
method: Soften the sliced onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until thick. Season.
Make four hollows in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook gently for 5-7 minutes until the whites are set.
Crumble over the feta and herbs and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Pistachio overnight oats with raspberry compote

ingredients.name: oat milk or other plant milk

method: Mix the oats, plant milk, yoghurt and half the maple syrup. Divide between two jars and chill overnight.
Simmer the raspberries with the remaining maple syrup and the lemon juice for 5 minutes until jammy, then cool.
In the morning, top the oats with the compote and pistachios.
notes: Make the night before.

recipes.name: Dark chocolate pistachio truffles
method: Heat the cream until steaming, pour over the chopped chocolate and butter, and stir until smooth.
Chill for 2 hours until firm.
Roll teaspoons of the mixture into balls and coat in chopped pistachios or cocoa. Keep in the fridge.
notes: Makes about 12 truffles. Chill for 2 hours.

recipes.name: Whipped feta with hot honey and sesame

ingredients.name: pitta breads or a selection of vegetables

method: Blend the feta and yoghurt until smooth and creamy.
Warm the honey with the chilli flakes for 1 minute.
Spread the feta into a bowl, drizzle with hot honey and oil, and scatter with sesame seeds. Serve with toasted pitta or vegetables.

recipes.name: Prosciutto-wrapped melon with basil
method: Peel and deseed the melon and cut into 8 wedges.
Wrap each wedge with a slice of prosciutto and a basil leaf.
Drizzle with olive oil and finish with black pepper.

recipes.name: Citrus-marinated olives and toasted almonds
method: Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 4-5 minutes, then sprinkle with a little salt.
Warm the oil with strips of orange and lemon zest, the fennel seeds and chilli for 2 minutes.
Toss the olives in the warm oil with a squeeze of orange juice. Serve with the almonds.
notes: Best left to marinate for at least 1 hour.

recipes.name: Cucumber rounds with crab, lime and chilli
method: Slice the cucumber into thick rounds.
Mix the crab with the mayonnaise, lime zest and juice, and seasoning.
Spoon onto the cucumber and top with finely sliced chilli and coriander.

recipes.name: Thai green chicken curry with jasmine rice
method: Rinse the rice and cook in 600ml water, covered, for 12 minutes. Rest for 5 minutes.
Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute. Add the sliced chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the beans and sliced courgette for 5 minutes. Season with fish sauce and lime juice.
Serve with the rice and fresh herbs.

recipes.name: Korean bibimbap with gochujang vegetables and egg
method: Cook the rice for 12 minutes, then rest covered.
Cut the carrot and courgette into matchsticks. Stir-fry each vegetable separately in a little oil for 2-3 minutes, seasoning each with a dash of soy sauce.
Mix the gochujang with the sesame oil and 1 tbsp water.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks runny.
Divide the rice between bowls, arrange the vegetables on top, add the egg and finish with the sauce and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Jerk chicken with pineapple salsa and coconut rice
method: Rub the chicken with the jerk seasoning, oil and half the lime juice. Leave for 15 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Roast the chicken for 35 minutes until cooked through and charred.
Rinse the rice. Simmer with the coconut milk, 200ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 12 minutes. Rest for 5 minutes.
Dice the pineapple, red onion and chilli, then mix with the coriander and remaining lime juice.
Serve the chicken with the coconut rice and pineapple salsa.

recipes.name: Persian pomegranate chicken with saffron rice
method: Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp hot water.
Brown the chicken in the oil, then remove. Soften the sliced onion for 6 minutes, then add the cinnamon and turmeric.
Return the chicken with the molasses, honey and stock. Simmer for 25 minutes until sticky and tender.
Cook the rice for 12 minutes, then stir through the saffron water.
Serve the chicken on the rice, scattered with walnuts and pomegranate seeds.

recipes.name: Moroccan lamb tagine with apricots and almonds

ingredients.name: ras el hanout or mixed Moroccan spice

method: Brown the lamb in batches in the oil, then remove.
Soften the chopped onions for 8 minutes, then add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Return the lamb with the tomatoes, stock and apricots. Cover and simmer gently for 1.5 hours.
Add the drained chickpeas and cook uncovered for 20 minutes more until the lamb is tender.
Pour 300ml boiling water over the couscous and cover for 5 minutes. Serve the tagine on the couscous with almonds and coriander.

recipes.name: Goan coconut fish curry

ingredients.name: firm white fish fillets (such as cod or pollock)

method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, chilli and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cut the fish into chunks, add to the sauce and poach gently for 5-6 minutes until just cooked.
Cook the rice for 12 minutes. Finish the curry with lime juice and coriander and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Vietnamese caramel tofu with lime and herbs
method: Press the tofu between kitchen paper, then cut into cubes. Cook the rice.
Fry the tofu in the oil until golden on all sides, then remove.
Melt the sugar in the pan with 2 tbsp water until it turns a deep amber caramel. Carefully add the soy sauce, vinegar, garlic and chilli.
Return the tofu and toss until glossy and sticky.
Serve on the rice with lime juice and plenty of herbs.
notes: Vegan: no fish sauce.

recipes.name: Turkish imam bayildi stuffed aubergines
method: Heat the oven to 190C (170C fan). Halve the aubergines lengthways, score the flesh, brush with half the oil and roast cut-side down for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, soften the sliced onions in the remaining oil for 12 minutes. Add the garlic, chopped tomatoes, cinnamon and sugar, and cook for 8 minutes.
Press the aubergine flesh down to make a hollow and fill with the onion mix.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until very soft. Finish with parsley and lemon, and serve warm or at room temperature with flatbread.

recipes.name: Crispy chilli beef with sesame greens
method: Cook the rice. Slice the beef into thin strips and toss in the cornflour with a pinch of salt.
Fry the beef in hot oil in batches until crisp, then drain on kitchen paper.
Stir-fry the sliced pepper, carrot, garlic and chilli for 3 minutes.
Add the sweet chilli sauce, soy sauce and vinegar, bubble briefly, then toss the beef back through.
Stir-fry the greens with the sesame oil for 2 minutes. Serve everything with the rice and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Tandoori salmon with mint yoghurt
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Mix 1 tbsp yoghurt with the tandoori spice and half the lemon juice. Coat the salmon.
Roast for 12-15 minutes until just cooked. Cook the rice alongside.
Mix the remaining yoghurt with chopped mint, grated cucumber and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve the salmon on the rice with lettuce and the mint yoghurt.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma bowls with garlic sauce
method: Toss the chicken with the spices, half the lemon juice, 1 crushed garlic clove and the oil. Leave for 10 minutes.
Cook the chicken under a hot grill or in a griddle pan for 6-7 minutes each side until charred and cooked through. Rest, then slice.
Mix the yoghurt with the remaining garlic, lemon juice and seasoning.
Dice the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion.
Serve the chicken over rice (or in flatbreads) with the salad and garlic sauce.

recipes.name: Paneer tikka masala with fragrant rice
method: Cube the paneer and fry in half the oil until golden. Set aside.
Soften the chopped onion in the remaining oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and curry paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the cream and garam masala.
Add the paneer and simmer for 5 minutes. Cook the rice.
Serve the curry with the rice and coriander.

recipes.name: Miso sesame soba with edamame
method: Cook the soba noodles for 4-5 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 3 minutes. Rinse under cold water.
Whisk the miso, soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar and maple syrup with 1 tbsp water.
Toss the noodles and edamame with the dressing, grated carrot and sliced spring onions.
Finish with sesame seeds. Serve warm or cold.
notes: Check the noodle label: many soba noodles contain wheat.

recipes.name: Cajun prawn tacos with mango slaw
method: Shred the cabbage, dice the mango and toss together with half the lime juice and coriander.
Toss the prawns in the Cajun seasoning and fry in the oil for 2-3 minutes until pink.
Mix the mayonnaise with the remaining lime juice.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, prawns and lime mayo.

recipes.name: Greek lemon-oregano chicken traybake
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the potatoes into wedges and the onion and pepper into chunks.
Toss everything in a large tray with the oil, oregano, lemon juice and zest, garlic and seasoning.
Nestle in the chicken, skin up, and roast for 45 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Scatter with crumbled feta and olives for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Japanese chicken katsu curry
method: For the sauce: soften the chopped onion and carrots in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, curry powder and 1 tbsp flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the stock, then the soy sauce and honey. Simmer for 15 minutes and blend until smooth.
Flatten the chicken to an even thickness. Coat in flour, then beaten egg, then panko.
Fry in the remaining oil for 4-5 minutes each side until golden and cooked through. Cook the rice.
Slice the katsu and serve on the rice with the curry sauce.

recipes.name: Creamy sun-dried tomato gnocchi with spinach
method: Fry the gnocchi in 1 tbsp of the sun-dried tomato oil for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Pour in the cream and simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the cheese.
Season and serve with basil.

recipes.name: Sichuan mapo tofu (meat-free)

ingredients.name: block of silken or firm tofu

method: Cook the rice. Cut the tofu into cubes.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil until browned. Add the chilli bean paste, garlic, ginger and Sichuan pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stock and soy sauce, then slide in the tofu. Simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Mix the cornflour with 2 tbsp water, stir in and simmer until glossy.
Serve over rice with sliced spring onions.

recipes.name: Prawn laksa with rice noodles
method: Fry the laksa paste in a pan for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and stock and simmer for 8 minutes.
Soak or cook the noodles according to the packet. Add the prawns to the soup for 3 minutes until pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice.
Divide the noodles between bowls, ladle over the soup and top with beansprouts, chilli and coriander.

recipes.name: Roasted vegetable and chickpea harissa couscous
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Chop the vegetables and toss with the drained chickpeas, harissa and oil.
Roast for 20-25 minutes until charred at the edges.
Pour 200ml boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with lemon juice.
Fold the roasted vegetables into the couscous and finish with herbs.

recipes.name: Falafel pita with tahini slaw
method: Drain and dry the chickpeas. Blitz with the onion, garlic, herbs, cumin and flour until coarse. Shape into 10 small patties.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and 2-3 tbsp water, then toss with the shredded cabbage.
Warm the pittas and fill with the falafel and tahini slaw.

recipes.name: Thai peanut noodle salad with crunchy vegetables
method: Cook the noodles, then rinse under cold water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup and lime juice with 2-3 tbsp warm water.
Cut the vegetables into thin strips.
Toss the noodles with the vegetables and dressing. Top with coriander and peanuts.

recipes.name: Halloumi and roasted pepper wraps

ingredients.name: roasted red peppers from a jar

method: Slice the halloumi and fry in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Slice the peppers.
Spread the wraps with hummus, then add the rocket, peppers and halloumi. Squeeze over lemon and roll up.

recipes.name: Tuna niçoise-inspired salad
method: Boil the potatoes for 12-15 minutes until tender, adding the green beans for the last 4 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar and oil.
Arrange the lettuce, halved potatoes, beans, tomatoes, olives, tuna and halved eggs. Drizzle with the dressing.

recipes.name: Chicken banh mi-style baguette
method: Shred the carrot and cut the cucumber into ribbons. Soak in the vinegar and sugar for 10 minutes.
Toss the chicken in the soy sauce and honey and cook in a griddle pan for 4-5 minutes each side until cooked through. Slice.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha.
Split the baguettes, spread with the spicy mayo and fill with chicken, pickled vegetables and coriander.

recipes.name: Mediterranean butter bean bruschetta
method: Drain the butter beans and roughly crush with half the oil, lemon juice and seasoning.
Toast the bread and rub with the cut garlic clove.
Chop the tomatoes and toss with basil and the remaining oil.
Top the toast with the crushed beans and tomatoes.

recipes.name: Prawn and avocado lime rice bowls
method: Cook the rice, then stir through the lime zest and half the lime juice.
Whisk the remaining lime juice with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Slice the avocado, cucumber and radishes.
Top the rice with the prawns and vegetables, then drizzle with the dressing and add coriander.

recipes.name: Spiced lentil and roasted carrot salad
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the carrots into batons, toss with the spices and half the oil, and roast for 25 minutes.
Whisk the remaining oil with the lemon juice and maple syrup.
Toss the drained lentils, rocket and parsley with the dressing.
Top with the roasted carrots and pumpkin seeds.

recipes.name: Greek chicken souvlaki flatbreads
method: Cut the chicken into chunks and toss with the lemon juice, oregano, half the garlic and the oil. Thread onto skewers if you like.
Grill or griddle for 10-12 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Mix the yoghurt with the grated cucumber and remaining garlic to make tzatziki.
Warm the flatbreads and fill with chicken, tomato, red onion and tzatziki.

recipes.name: Miso mushroom udon soup
method: Fry the sliced mushrooms in the sesame oil until golden.
Bring the stock to a simmer, then whisk in the miso and soy sauce. Don't let it boil hard after adding the miso.
Add the udon and pak choi and heat for 2-3 minutes.
Serve in bowls topped with the mushrooms and sliced spring onions.

recipes.name: Turkish eggs with chilli butter and yoghurt
method: Mix the yoghurt with the grated garlic and a pinch of salt. Spread onto two plates.
Poach the eggs in gently simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes.
Melt the butter with the chilli and paprika until sizzling.
Place the eggs on the yoghurt, spoon over the chilli butter and finish with dill. Serve with toast.

recipes.name: Mango coconut chia pudding
method: Mix the chia seeds, coconut milk and maple syrup. Stir again after 10 minutes, then chill overnight.
Blend half the mango with the lime juice into a purée and dice the rest.
Layer the chia pudding with the mango purée and diced mango. Top with coconut.
notes: Make the night before.

recipes.name: Breakfast burrito with black beans and salsa
method: Warm the drained black beans with the cumin and a splash of water, then roughly mash.
Scramble the eggs in the oil over a low heat until just set.
Warm the tortillas. Fill with beans, eggs, cheese, salsa and sliced avocado.
Fold into burritos and toast seam-side down in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes.

recipes.name: Savoury miso oats with sesame mushrooms
method: Simmer the oats in 500ml water for 5 minutes until creamy. Stir in the miso off the heat.
Fry the sliced mushrooms in the sesame oil until golden, then add the soy sauce.
Top the oats with the mushrooms, sliced spring onions, sesame seeds and chilli.

recipes.name: Blueberry lemon baked oats
method: Heat the oven to 180C (160C fan). Mash the banana, then mix with the egg, milk, lemon zest and honey.
Stir in the oats and baking powder, then fold in most of the blueberries.
Pour into a small baking dish, scatter over the remaining berries and bake for 25-30 minutes until set and golden.

recipes.name: Spinach and feta egg muffins
method: Heat the oven to 190C (170C fan). Oil a 6-hole muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and seasoning. Chop the spinach and spring onions and add.
Divide between the holes, crumble over the feta and add half a tomato to each.
Bake for 18-20 minutes until set.
notes: Makes 6 muffins. Keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

recipes.name: Avocado toast with chilli-crisp eggs
method: Toast the sourdough. Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and seasoning and spread on the toast.
Heat the chilli crisp and vegetable oil in a pan and fry the eggs until the edges are crisp and the yolks runny.
Slide the eggs onto the toast and spoon over the chilli oil from the pan.

recipes.name: Banana tahini smoothie bowl
method: Blend the frozen banana, tahini, plant milk and maple syrup until thick and smooth.
Pour into bowls and top with granola, sliced kiwi and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Cinnamon pear bircher muesli
method: Mix the oats with the apple juice, yoghurt and cinnamon. Chill overnight.
In the morning, grate in half the pear and stir.
Top with the remaining sliced pear, hazelnuts and honey.
notes: Make the night before.

recipes.name: Masala omelette with coriander
method: Finely chop the onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Whisk the eggs with the turmeric, cumin, chopped vegetables, herbs and seasoning.
Pour into a hot oiled pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, then fold and cook for 1 minute more.

recipes.name: Crispy air-fryer chickpeas with smoked paprika
method: Drain and dry the chickpeas well.
Toss with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Air-fry at 200C for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway, until crunchy. They crisp up more as they cool.
notes: No air fryer? Roast at 200C (180C fan) for 25-30 minutes.

recipes.name: Edamame with chilli lime salt
method: Boil the edamame for 4-5 minutes, then drain.
Mix the salt, chilli and lime zest.
Toss the edamame with the salt mix and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Mango lassi with cardamom
method: Blend everything until smooth.
Serve chilled, with a pinch of cardamom on top.

recipes.name: Peanut butter date bites
method: Blitz everything in a food processor until it sticks together.
Roll into 12 balls and chill for 30 minutes.
notes: Makes about 12. Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.name: Mini caprese skewers
method: Thread tomatoes, basil leaves and mozzarella onto small skewers.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze and season with pepper.

recipes.name: Spiced roasted nuts with rosemary
method: Heat the oven to 180C (160C fan).
Toss the nuts with the oil, chopped rosemary, maple syrup, paprika and salt.
Roast for 10-12 minutes, stirring once, until golden. Cool before eating.

recipes.name: Apple slices with almond butter and cinnamon
method: Core and slice the apple.
Spread or dip with almond butter and dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Greek yoghurt with honey and toasted seeds
method: Toast the seeds in a dry pan for 2-3 minutes.
Top the yoghurt with the seeds and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Hummus with crunchy rainbow vegetables
method: Cut the vegetables into sticks.
Serve with the hummus.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese with pineapple and lime

ingredients.name: pineapple, fresh or tinned in juice

method: Dice the pineapple.
Top the cottage cheese with pineapple, lime zest and juice, and a pinch of chilli.

recipes.name: Smoky black bean chilli with lime rice
method: Soften the chopped onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, purée and drained beans with 150ml water. Simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Cook the rice, then stir through the lime zest, juice and chopped coriander.
Serve the chilli over the lime rice.

recipes.name: Red lentil coconut dhal with turmeric rice
method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, coconut milk and stock. Simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Cook the rice with a pinch of turmeric. Stir the spinach and lemon juice into the dhal.
Serve the dhal with the rice.

recipes.name: Caramelised onion and chickpea curry
method: Slowly cook the sliced onions in the oil for 15-20 minutes until deep golden.
Add the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, drained chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the garam masala. Serve with rice and coriander.

recipes.name: Tomato butter bean stew with garlic toast

ingredients.name: extra garlic clove for the toast

method: Gently cook the sliced garlic and paprika in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and drained beans and simmer for 8 minutes. Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Toast the bread and rub with the cut garlic.
Serve the stew with the garlic toast.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice with peas and spring onion
method: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok until very hot. Add the peas and spring onion whites for 2 minutes.
Push to one side, add the beaten eggs and scramble until just set.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until piping hot.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and top with the spring onion greens.
notes: Cold, day-old rice works best. Cool cooked rice quickly and keep it in the fridge for no more than 1 day.

recipes.name: Creamy lemon pea pasta
method: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes. Keep a cup of the water.
Drain, then return to the pan with the soft cheese, lemon zest and juice, and a splash of cooking water.
Toss until creamy. Finish with grated cheese and herbs.

recipes.name: Spanish-style chickpea and spinach stew
method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and drained chickpeas and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: One-pot smoky sausage and bean casserole

ingredients.name: potatoes, or crusty bread to serve

method: Brown the sausages in the oil, then cut into chunks.
Soften the chopped onion and pepper for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, drained beans, stock and sausages. Simmer for 20-25 minutes until thick.
Serve with boiled potatoes or crusty bread.

recipes.name: Tinned sardine tomato spaghetti with parsley
method: Cook the spaghetti.
Gently cook the garlic and chilli in the oil for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the sardines, breaking them into chunks, and warm through.
Toss with the pasta, lemon zest and parsley.

recipes.name: Crispy potato and black bean tacos
method: Dice the potatoes into 1cm cubes. Fry in the oil for 15-20 minutes, turning, until crisp and cooked through. Toss with the spices.
Warm the drained beans with a splash of water and lightly mash.
Warm the tortillas and fill with beans, potatoes, avocado and salsa. Finish with lime.

recipes.name: Chicken thigh traybake with paprika potatoes
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the potatoes into chunks and the onions into wedges.
Toss with the oil, paprika, garlic and seasoning in a large roasting tin.
Add the chicken, skin-side up, rub with a little more paprika and roast for 45 minutes until cooked through.
Steam the greens and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Tuna and sweetcorn pasta bake
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk gradually. Simmer until thick, then add the mustard and most of the cheese.
Mix the pasta, tuna and sweetcorn into the sauce. Tip into a dish and top with the remaining cheese.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Lentil bolognese with spaghetti
method: Finely chop the onion, carrots and celery and soften in the oil for 10 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the drained lentils, tomatoes, purée and oregano. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the bolognese.

recipes.name: Cabbage and egg stir-fry noodles
method: Cook the noodles, then drain.
Stir-fry the shredded cabbage, grated carrot and garlic in the oil for 3-4 minutes.
Push to one side, scramble the eggs, then toss everything with the noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Sweet potato and peanut stew
method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the peeled, diced sweet potato, tomatoes, peanut butter and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes until the potato is tender.
Stir in the greens until wilted. Cook the rice.
Serve the stew with rice, topped with chopped peanuts.

recipes.name: Moroccan carrot and chickpea couscous
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the carrots into chunks and toss with the drained chickpeas, spices and oil. Roast for 25 minutes.
Pour 200ml boiling water over the couscous and raisins, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with lemon juice.
Fold through the roasted carrots and chickpeas, and finish with herbs.

recipes.name: Tomato and egg shakshuka with toast
method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 6 minutes.
Make four hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5-6 minutes until the whites are set.
Serve with toast.

recipes.name: Ginger garlic tofu and cabbage rice bowls
method: Cook the rice. Press the tofu, cut into cubes and toss in the cornflour.
Fry the tofu in the oil until crisp, then remove.
Stir-fry the shredded cabbage with the garlic and ginger for 4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, maple syrup and vinegar, then return the tofu and toss to coat. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Cheesy broccoli baked potatoes
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Prick the potatoes and bake for 50-60 minutes until crisp outside and soft inside.
Steam the broccoli florets for 4 minutes, then chop.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out and mash the flesh with the crème fraîche, mustard, broccoli and most of the cheese.
Spoon back into the skins, top with the remaining cheese and bake for 10 minutes until golden.
notes: Short on time? Microwave the potatoes for 8-10 minutes, then crisp in the oven for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Budget chicken and vegetable noodle soup
method: Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the stock and whole chicken. Simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, then lift out and shred.
Add the noodles and peas to the pot and cook for 4-5 minutes.
Return the chicken, season and finish with parsley.

recipes.name: Pasta e ceci (Italian chickpea pasta)
method: Gently cook the garlic, rosemary and chilli in the oil for 2 minutes. Stir in the tomato purée.
Add the chickpeas (with their liquid) and the stock. Simmer for 5 minutes, then mash a third of the chickpeas to thicken.
Add the pasta and cook, stirring often, for 10-12 minutes until tender and thick. Add water if needed.
Season and finish with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Curried potato and pea samosa bowls
method: Cut the potatoes into 2cm cubes and boil for 8 minutes, then drain.
Fry the cumin seeds and chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and curry powder.
Add the potatoes and fry until crisp at the edges. Stir in the peas for 3 minutes.
Cook the rice. Serve in bowls topped with the samosa filling, chutney and coriander.

recipes.name: Roasted cauliflower with spiced lentils
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Cut the cauliflower into florets, toss with half the oil and spices and roast for 25 minutes.
Soften the chopped onion and garlic in the remaining oil, then add the drained lentils and the rest of the spices. Warm through.
Finish the lentils with lemon juice and parsley and serve topped with the cauliflower, with a spoonful of yoghurt if you like.

recipes.name: Chilli garlic tinned mackerel rice
method: Cook the rice, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp of oil from the mackerel tin and fry the garlic and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the flaked mackerel and soy sauce and warm through.
Spoon over the rice and finish with spring onions and lime.

recipes.name: Mexican rice and bean stuffed peppers
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Halve and deseed the peppers and roast for 10 minutes.
Mix the rice, drained beans and sweetcorn, half the tomatoes, the spices and seasoning.
Fill the peppers, spoon the remaining tomatoes around them and bake for 25 minutes.
Finish with lime and coriander.

recipes.name: Lemon white bean mash on toast
method: Drain the beans and mash with the lemon zest and juice, grated garlic, oil and seasoning.
Toast the bread.
Spread thickly with the bean mash and top with chilli and parsley.

recipes.name: Curried chickpea sandwich filling
method: Roughly mash the drained chickpeas.
Mix with the mayonnaise, curry powder, chutney and finely chopped celery.
Make sandwiches with the filling and lettuce.

recipes.name: Egg and cress yoghurt sandwiches
method: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Mash with the yoghurt, mayonnaise, mustard and seasoning.
Spread on the bread, add plenty of cress and make sandwiches.

recipes.name: Tomato lentil soup with toasted bread
method: Soften the chopped onion and carrots in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and cumin.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Blend until smooth, season, and serve with toast.

recipes.name: Tuna sweetcorn jacket potato
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Prick the potatoes and bake for 50-60 minutes.
Mix the tuna, sweetcorn, mayonnaise and black pepper.
Split the potatoes and fill with the tuna mix. Serve with salad.
notes: Short on time? Microwave the potatoes for 8-10 minutes.

recipes.name: Peanut sesame noodles with shredded cabbage
method: Cook the noodles and rinse in cold water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil and vinegar with 2 tbsp warm water.
Toss the noodles with the finely shredded cabbage and dressing, then top with spring onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Black bean quesadillas with salsa
method: Drain the beans and mash with the cumin and lime juice.
Spread over two tortillas, scatter with cheese and top with the other tortillas.
Cook in a dry pan for 2-3 minutes each side until crisp and melted. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Crispy chickpea and cucumber wraps
method: Fry the drained, dried chickpeas in the oil with the paprika for 8-10 minutes until crisp.
Spread the wraps with hummus, then add lettuce, sliced cucumber and chickpeas.
Squeeze over lemon and roll up.

recipes.name: Homemade minestrone with beans
method: Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and shredded cabbage and cook for 10 minutes more. Season.

recipes.name: Sardine lemon pepper toast
method: Toast the bread.
Mash the sardines with a little of their oil, the lemon zest and juice and plenty of black pepper.
Spread on the toast and finish with parsley.

recipes.name: Roasted vegetable hummus pitas
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Chop the vegetables, toss with the oil and herbs and roast for 25 minutes.
Warm the pittas, spread with hummus, and fill with spinach and the roasted vegetables.

recipes.name: Egg salad rice bowls with pickles
method: Cook the rice. Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.
Chop the eggs and mix with the mayonnaise, spring onion and seasoning.
Serve the egg salad on the rice with pickles, sliced cucumber and a dash of soy sauce.

recipes.name: Spiced carrot soup with yoghurt swirl
method: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the spices for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth and season. Serve with a swirl of yoghurt.

recipes.name: Leftover chilli loaded potatoes
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Prick and bake the potatoes for 50-60 minutes (or microwave for 8-10 minutes).
Reheat the chilli until piping hot.
Split the potatoes and fill with chilli, yoghurt and sliced spring onions.
notes: Uses leftovers from recipe 081.

recipes.name: Pesto pea and butter bean pasta salad
method: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water.
Toss with the drained butter beans, pesto and lemon juice.
Fold through the rocket. Serve cold or at room temperature.
notes: Uses vegetarian pesto (made without parmesan), so it's suitable for vegetarians.

recipes.name: Cinnamon apple porridge
method: Grate the apple.
Simmer the oats, milk, apple and cinnamon for 5-6 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Serve with a drizzle of maple syrup.

recipes.name: Peanut butter banana overnight oats
method: Mix the oats, milk, peanut butter and half the mashed banana. Chill overnight.
Top with the remaining sliced banana and maple syrup.
notes: Make the night before.

recipes.name: Soft boiled eggs and wholemeal soldiers
method: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 6 minutes for runny yolks.
Toast and butter the bread, then cut into soldiers.
Serve the eggs in egg cups with the soldiers.

recipes.name: Budget berry yoghurt oats
method: Mix the oats into the yoghurt and leave for 5 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Top with the berries and honey.

recipes.name: Tomato and egg breakfast wraps
method: Scramble the eggs in the oil until just set, adding the chopped tomatoes for the last minute.
Warm the wraps, fill with the eggs and cheese and roll up.

recipes.name: Banana oat pancakes
method: Blend the banana, eggs, oats and baking powder into a batter.
Fry small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan for 2 minutes each side.
Serve with yoghurt and fruit.

recipes.name: Baked beans with chilli on toast
method: Heat the beans with the chilli flakes.
Toast the bread and spread lightly.
Spoon the beans over the toast.
notes: Check the label: some breads contain milk.

recipes.name: Savoury spring onion porridge with egg
method: Simmer the oats in the stock for 5-6 minutes until creamy.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Serve the porridge topped with an egg, sliced spring onions, soy sauce and chilli.

recipes.name: Cocoa banana overnight oats
method: Mix the oats, milk, cocoa and half the mashed banana. Chill overnight.
Top with the remaining sliced banana and maple syrup.
notes: Make the night before.

recipes.name: Cinnamon raisin rice pudding oats
method: Simmer the oats, milk, raisins and cinnamon for 6-8 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy, like rice pudding.
Sweeten with maple syrup.

recipes.name: Popcorn with smoked paprika
method: Heat the oil in a large pan with a lid. Add the kernels, cover and shake over a medium heat until the popping slows.
Toss with the paprika and salt.

recipes.name: Frozen banana cocoa bites
method: Slice the bananas into rounds and freeze on a tray for 1 hour.
Melt the chocolate, dip in the banana slices and refreeze until set. Dust with cocoa.
notes: Freeze for at least 2 hours. Check the chocolate label for milk.

recipes.name: Roasted carrot sticks with cumin yoghurt
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the carrots into sticks, toss with the oil and half the cumin, and roast for 25 minutes.
Mix the yoghurt with the remaining cumin, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Serve the carrots with the yoghurt dip.

recipes.name: Homemade oat and raisin flapjacks
method: Heat the oven to 180C (160C fan) and line a 20cm square tin.
Melt the butter, syrup and sugar, then stir in the oats and raisins.
Press into the tin and bake for 20-25 minutes until golden. Cut while warm and cool in the tin.
notes: Makes 12 squares.

recipes.name: Hard-boiled eggs with chilli salt
method: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Mix the salt and chilli and sprinkle over the halved eggs.

recipes.name: Apple and peanut butter toast
method: Toast the bread and spread with peanut butter.
Top with thin slices of apple and a pinch of cinnamon.

recipes.name: Cucumber and lemon chickpea dip
method: Blend the drained chickpeas with the lemon juice, garlic, oil and 2-3 tbsp water until smooth.
Stir through the finely diced cucumber and herbs. Serve with vegetable sticks.

recipes.name: Crispy roasted potato wedges with salsa
method: Heat the oven to 220C (200C fan). Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with the oil, paprika and salt.
Roast for 30-35 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Yoghurt with grated apple and cinnamon
method: Grate the apple into the yoghurt and stir.
Dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Rice cakes with mashed banana and seeds
method: Mash the banana and spread over the rice cakes.
Sprinkle with the seeds.
